blocks.text: Electrostatics, ya saakin bijli (static electricity), rest mein bijli ke charges ke asraat ka mutala hai: charges ki aik doosre par quwwatein, un se paida hone wala electric field aur electric potential, aur khala aur aalaat mein jama bijli ki tawanai.

Hum pehle parh chuke hain ke charge apne gird electric field banata hai; is field mein rakha koi doosra charge quwwat mehsoos karta hai. Electrostatic quwwat Coulomb ke qanoon se milti hai, Fe = (1/4 pi eo) q1 q2 / r^2, aur is ki simt is par munhasir hai ke charges musbat hain ya manfi. Yeh chapter kisi charge se us ke field ke har nuqte par paida hone wala electric potential parhta hai, dikhata hai ke bijli ki tawanai aur charge capacitor naam ke aam aale mein kaise jama hote hain, aur capacitors ke kuch ahem istemal batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Coulomb ka qanoon kya deta hai, aur quwwat ki simt kis par munhasir hai?
blocks.explanation: Do point charges ke darmiyan electrostatic quwwat, Fe = (1/4 pi eo) q1 q2 / r^2; is ki simt charges ke nishan par munhasir hai (aik jaise dhakelte, mukhtalif kheenchte hain).

items: Electrostatics: rest mein charges, un ki quwwatein, fields, potentials aur jama tawanai.
Coulomb ka qanoon: Fe = (1/4 pi eo) q1 q2 / r^2.
